topic.title: Neural Training Dynamics and Feature-Learning Regimes
topic.overview: This topic asks how neural networks change during optimization and why different parameterizations produce different learning behavior. The papers analyze wide-network limits, stochastic dynamics, convergence, and the geometry of Jacobians. A central distinction is whether training mainly adjusts predictions around fixed initial features or substantially learns new representations.
topic.whyItMatters: A convergence guarantee alone does not explain why learned features are useful. Connecting parameterization and depth to representation changes can clarify when simplified theories describe practical networks and when their assumptions exclude the behavior of interest.
topic.evolution: Early representatives use statistical mechanics and linear models to study learning dynamics. Later papers examine linearized wide networks and richer infinite-width parameterizations. Recent work studies spectral separation and singular-vector alignment in deep Jacobians, with experiments restricted to settings that support the proposed approximation.
openQuestions: Which predictions from infinite-width or fixed-activation analyses remain reliable when finite networks change their activation patterns?

papers.title: Phase diagram of early training dynamics in deep neural networks: effect of the learning rate, depth, and width
papers.tldr: Early SGD dynamics exhibit distinct phases, including a sharpness-reduction phase that emerges as networks become deeper and narrower.

papers.title: Rethinking Gauss-Newton for learning over-parameterized models
papers.tldr: Gauss–Newton converges quickly in the studied networks, but synthetic experiments show that slowing it can favor features and solutions that generalize better.

papers.title: Saddle-to-Saddle Dynamics in Diagonal Linear Networks
papers.tldr: For diagonal linear regression networks with vanishing initialization, gradient flow follows a characterized sequence of saddles toward a minimum one-norm solution.

papers.title: ScaleLong: Towards More Stable Training of Diffusion Model via Scaling Network Long Skip Connection
papers.tldr: ScaleLong rescales long skip connections to stabilize diffusion-model training, with theoretical support and reported acceleration of about 1.5 times.

papers.title: Spectral Evolution and Invariance in Linear-width Neural Networks
papers.tldr: Different training strategies produce stable, spiked, or heavy-tailed matrix spectra that help characterize neural-network feature learning.

papers.title: Stochastic Collapse: How Gradient Noise Attracts SGD Dynamics Towards Simpler Subnetworks
papers.tldr: Gradient noise can attract SGD toward simpler subnetworks, providing a mechanism for reduced complexity and improved generalization.

papers.title: Strategic Distribution Shift of Interacting Agents via Coupled Gradient Flows
papers.tldr: Coupled population and learning dynamics model strategic distribution shifts and yield convergence guarantees in the studied cooperative and competitive settings.

papers.title: The Quantization Model of Neural Scaling
papers.tldr: The Quantization Model explains scaling through discrete skills learned by frequency, with toy-data validation and tentative supporting evidence from language models.

papers.title: Trajectory Alignment: Understanding the Edge of Stability Phenomenon via Bifurcation Theory
papers.tldr: Aligned gradient-descent trajectories provide a bifurcation-based explanation of progressive sharpening and edge-of-stability behavior, with proofs for specific simple networks.

papers.title: Wide Neural Networks as Gaussian Processes: Lessons from Deep Equilibrium Models
papers.tldr: Wide deep equilibrium models converge to Gaussian processes with interchangeable depth and width limits and non-degenerate kernels on distinct inputs.

papers.title: A Dynamical Model of Neural Scaling Laws
papers.tldr: A solvable training model explains several neural scaling patterns and predicts increasing training steps faster than model size when allocating compute.

papers.title: An Infinite-Width Analysis on the Jacobian-Regularised Training of a Neural Network
papers.tldr: An infinite-width theory jointly describes neural network predictions, input sensitivities, and training with Jacobian regularization.

papers.title: Asymptotics of feature learning in two-layer networks after one gradient-step

papers.title: Critical feature learning in deep neural networks
papers.tldr: A finite-width kernel theory links feature learning to fluctuations in a network’s Bayesian prior and their alignment with training targets.

papers.title: Deep Equilibrium Models are Almost Equivalent to Not-so-deep Explicit Models for High-dimensional Gaussian Mixtures
papers.tldr: For high-dimensional Gaussian mixtures, a compact kernel analysis shows how shallow explicit networks can match key kernels of deep equilibrium models.

papers.title: Keep the Momentum: Conservation Laws beyond Euclidean Gradient Flows
papers.tldr: A general conservation-law framework shows that momentum introduces time dependence and often removes invariants present in gradient flow.

papers.title: Mean-field Analysis on Two-layer Neural Networks from a Kernel Perspective
papers.tldr: Under a two-timescale mean-field limit, two-layer networks learn adaptive kernels with global convergence guarantees and characterized discretization errors.

papers.title: MLI Formula: A Nearly Scale-Invariant Solution with Noise Perturbation
papers.tldr: The paper interprets monotonic interpolation through near scale invariance and changing noise, suggesting trained-model properties may explain much of the phenomenon.

papers.title: On the Implicit Bias of Adam
papers.tldr: Adam and RMSProp have implicit gradient effects whose direction depends on hyperparameters and training stage.

papers.title: The Benefits of Reusing Batches for Gradient Descent in Two-Layer Networks: Breaking the Curse of Information and Leap Exponents
papers.tldr: Reusing batches with finite-step gradient descent lets two-layer networks overcome learnability barriers associated with single-pass training and gradient flow.

papers.title: 4+3 Phases of Compute-Optimal Neural Scaling Laws
papers.tldr: A solvable scaling model reveals distinct regimes for allocating compute to neural-network size.

papers.title: A generalized neural tangent kernel for surrogate gradient learning
papers.tldr: A generalized neural tangent kernel provides a rigorous framework for analyzing neural networks trained with surrogate derivatives.

papers.title: Analyzing & Reducing the Need for Learning Rate Warmup in GPT Training
papers.tldr: In small-scale GPT training, directly normalizing optimizer updates can substantially reduce or eliminate learning rate warmup.

papers.title: Global Convergence in Training Large-Scale Transformers
papers.tldr: The paper establishes a mean-field account of Transformer training and global convergence under its assumptions when weight decay is sufficiently small.

papers.title: Identifying Equivalent Training Dynamics

papers.title: Improving Adaptivity via Over-Parameterization in Sequence Models
papers.tldr: A sequence-model analysis shows that over-parameterized gradient flow can adapt to signal structure and improve generalization over ordinary gradient flow.

papers.title: Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Non-Homogeneous Two-Layer Networks: Margin Improvement and Fast Optimization
papers.tldr: Under stated network and data conditions, large gradient steps can transition from oscillating loss to efficient optimization with improving margins.

papers.title: Model Collapse Demystified: The Case of Regression
papers.tldr: An analysis of Gaussian regression quantifies recursive synthetic-data degradation and proposes adaptive regularization to mitigate it.

papers.title: On Feature Learning in Structured State Space Models
papers.tldr: An analysis of state-space model signals yields scaling rules that preserve feature learning where established parameterizations fail.

papers.title: On the Impacts of the Random Initialization in the Neural Tangent Kernel Theory
papers.tldr: Accounting for ordinary random initialization yields an NTK generalization lower bound that retains the curse of dimensionality.

papers.title: Parameter Symmetry and Noise Equilibrium of Stochastic Gradient Descent
papers.tldr: For exponential parameter symmetries, SGD noise drives a systematic flow toward a noise equilibrium, offering explanations for several training phenomena.

papers.title: Scaling Laws in Linear Regression: Compute, Parameters, and Data

papers.title: SGD vs GD: Rank Deficiency in Linear Networks

papers.title: Stepping on the Edge: Curvature Aware Learning Rate Tuners

papers.title: Stochastic Taylor Derivative Estimator: Efficient amortization for arbitrary differential operators

papers.title: Super Consistency of Neural Network Landscapes and Learning Rate Transfer

papers.title: The Feature Speed Formula: a flexible approach to scale hyper-parameters of deep neural networks

papers.title: Trade-Offs of Diagonal Fisher Information Matrix Estimators

papers.title: Where Do Large Learning Rates Lead Us?

papers.title: Why Transformers Need Adam: A Hessian Perspective

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework For Overfitting In Energy-based Modeling
papers.tldr: An analysis of learning timescales explains overfitting in pairwise energy-based models and motivates early stopping and shrinkage corrections.

papers.title: Adaptive kernel predictors from feature-learning infinite limits of neural networks

papers.title: Deep Linear Network Training Dynamics from Random Initialization: Data, Width, Depth, and Hyperparameter Transfer
papers.tldr: A theory of deep linear networks connects training dynamics to width, depth, data reuse, and hyperparameter transfer.

papers.title: Eigen Analysis of Conjugate Kernel and Neural Tangent Kernel

papers.title: Exact risk curves of signSGD in High-Dimensions: quantifying preconditioning and noise-compression effects

papers.title: Global Convergence and Rich Feature Learning in $L$-Layer Infinite-Width Neural Networks under $μ$ Parametrization

papers.title: Grokking at the Edge of Linear Separability

papers.title: How to set AdamW’s weight decay as you scale model and dataset size

papers.title: Mixture of Experts Provably Detect and Learn the Latent Cluster Structure in Gradient-Based Learning

papers.title: Models of Heavy-Tailed Mechanistic Universality

papers.title: On the Provable Separation of Scales in Maximal Update Parameterization

papers.title: Position: Solve Layerwise Linear Models First to Understand Neural Dynamical Phenomena (Neural Collapse, Emergence, Lazy/Rich Regime, and Grokking)

papers.title: Scaling Collapse Reveals Universal Dynamics in Compute-Optimally Trained Neural Networks

papers.title: Sharp Generalization for Nonparametric Regression by Over-Parameterized Neural Networks: A Distribution-Free Analysis in Spherical Covariate

papers.title: The Butterfly Effect: Neural Network Training Trajectories Are Highly Sensitive to Initial Conditions

papers.title: A Minimalist Example of Edge-of-Stability and Progressive Sharpening

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework for Grokking: Interpolation followed by Riemannian Norm Minimisation

papers.title: Alternating Gradient Flows: A Theory of Feature Learning in Two-layer Neural Networks

papers.title: Convergence of the Gradient Flow for Shallow ReLU Networks on Weakly Interacting Data

papers.title: Convergence Rates for Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability for Overparametrised Least Squares

papers.title: Dynamical Decoupling of Generalization and Overfitting in Large Two-Layer Networks

papers.title: Emergence and scaling laws in SGD learning of shallow neural networks

papers.title: Flat Channels to Infinity in Neural Loss Landscapes

papers.title: Functional Scaling Laws in Kernel Regression: Loss Dynamics and Learning Rate Schedules

papers.title: Gompertz Linear Units: Leveraging Asymmetry for Enhanced Learning Dynamics

papers.title: Is Grokking a Computational Glass Relaxation?

papers.title: Just One Layer Norm Guarantees Stable Extrapolation

papers.title: Low Rank Gradients and Where to Find Them

papers.title: Neural Thermodynamics: Entropic Forces in Deep and Universal Representation Learning
papers.tldr: The paper develops an entropic-force theory linking training dynamics and parameter symmetries to representation alignment and sharpness-versus-flatness behavior.

papers.title: On the Surprising Effectiveness of Large Learning Rates under Standard Width Scaling

papers.title: Power Lines: Scaling laws for weight decay and batch size in LLM pre-training

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Gradient Descent and Sign Descent for Linear Bigram Models under Zipf’s Law

papers.title: The $\varphi$ Curve: The Shape of Generalization through the Lens of Norm-based Capacity Control

papers.title: Understanding Adam Requires Better Rotation Dependent Assumptions

papers.title: Understanding the Evolution of the Neural Tangent Kernel at the Edge of Stability

papers.title: Conservation Laws for Modern Neural Architectures

papers.title: Dichotomy of Feature Learning and Unlearning: Fast-Slow Analysis on Neural Networks with Stochastic Gradient Descent

papers.title: Joint Learning in the Gaussian Single Index Model

papers.title: Non-Euclidean Gradient Descent Operates at the Edge of Stability

papers.title: Stability Analysis of Sharpness-Aware Minimization

papers.title: Towards Understanding Adam Convergence on Highly Degenerate Polynomials

papers.title: TPV: Parameter Perturbations Through the Lens of Test Prediction Variance
